reviewed_by: Claude Code after scratch-Core reproduction on main (300k-message chat) and event-loop stall sampling
reason: A conversation's history is read in bounded keyset pages, one transaction each; CPU-heavy pure steps over it (history merge, context sources, compaction preparation, grouping, merging, digests, size estimates, context status estimation) run off the event loop above 2000 items; compaction source validation reads the session's own messages instead of offset-scanning the project; appends take MAX(sequence); a large full transcript streams. Selected: the new long-history regressions on SQLite and PostgreSQL (paged order, limits and cursors, aggregate sequence, off-loop equivalence, source validation, streamed transcript equality, loop responsiveness) and the chat API, context, retrieval, context assembly, chat switch, catch-up, recent page, polling cost and agent message suites; runtime coordination provides the PostgreSQL runtime.
exclusions: No UI, native, browser or Playwright layer: no response shape or control changed (the streamed transcript is the same JSON array). No settings or settings-assistant destination changed. The 300k-message worker behaviour was verified on scratch Cores by script.
